title: Bundu Conversation Interchange (BCI) 0.1.0 (draft): one record
description: One line of a BCI stream. Each record has a `type`; the schema for that type applies. See README.md.

uuid.description: A UUID (RFC 9562), lower case. Version 7 is recommended: it sorts by creation time.

scope.description: Whose knowledge an exchange is about. `personal` data is never sent to third-party inference and never trains a model.

language.description: A BCP 47 tag, for example en, sn, nd.

extensible.description: Extension members are named `<implementor>:<name>`. A reader ignores the ones it does not know and keeps them when it passes the record on.

name.description: The instrument or work, for example a statute's title.

headline.description: The part within it, for example a section heading.

validFrom.description: When the text took effect, when it is known.

Citation.description: A source behind an answer. The property names are schema.org's (CreativeWork) so a citation is valid JSON-LD without translation.

model.description: The model that produced the content, as the provider names it.

licenseClass.description: The model's licence class. `open_weight` is the only class whose output may train a model; null when there is no honest class.

c2pa.description: A C2PA manifest for the content, when there is one.

producer.description: The product that wrote the stream, for example shamwari.ai.

owner.description: An opaque identifier of the person the stream belongs to. Never an email address or a name.

updated.description: The time of the last message.

surface.description: Where it was held, for example web, lite, mobile, sms, ussd, cli.

project.description: The Project it is filed in, at most one.

sequence.description: 1, 2, 3 ... without gaps, in the order the messages happened.

item.description: An Open Responses item, unchanged: a `message` with its `role` and `content` parts, or a tool call, or an extension item (`<implementor>:<type>`). BCI adds no wire shape of its own.

trainable.description: Always false in an interchange stream: being stored or exported does not make a message training data. Whether anything may train a model is decided by the rules in README.md, never by this field being set.

instructions.description: Standing instructions for every conversation in the project, in the AGENTS.md style: plain Markdown.

skills.description: Agent Skills the project uses, by skill `name` (the Agent Skills specification's `name` field). The skills themselves are not embedded.

mediaType.description: An IANA media type. text/markdown for a saved answer.

text.description: The content, when it is text.

contentRef.description: Where the content is, when it is not inline. A relative path inside the archive, or a URL.

sha256.description: The digest of the content, so a copy can be checked.

derivedFrom.description: The conversation, and optionally the message, it came from. The conversation may no longer exist: an artifact survives its conversation.

license.description: An SPDX identifier or a URL.

consent.description: `stated`: the person said it. `confirmed`: the assistant inferred it and the person accepted it. There is no value for an inference the person has not seen.

source.description: The conversation it came from, when there is one.
